question: How does the practitioner utter the entire group of mantras and mudras in this state?
premises: The entire group of mantras and mudras is involved
The practitioner utters them in a stammering manner
This utterance is emphasized as actual
inference: In this state the practitioner stammeringly utters all mantras and mudras.
